en.text:
Switching to the Weapon grants 100 Ready/Stow Handling and a 0.95x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier for 1 second.

Buff is removed as soon as ADS input is pressed.

enhanced (
#e Passively grants 5 Reload Speed.
)

Hits inflict increased Flinch on Enemies.

<pve/>PVE: <link Tier 1-2 Minors [#CombatantClassifications] /> can be repeatedly staggered. Higher Tier Combatants stagger quicker.

<pvp/>PVP: Flinch against Players varies based on damage and Weapon Archetype. Flinch increase ranges between 5-10%.

Grants 5% increased damage against Elemental and <barrier/>Barrier Champion Shields.

Allows bullets to overpenetrate enemies once.

Aiming Down Sights grants the following benefits:
• 10 Range
• 10% increased Effective Zoom 
• 5% increased Projectile Speed

The Effective Zoom increase pushes out Aim Assist Falloff by 10%, reduces <title (Absolute) Recoil [absRecoil] /> by 10% and narrows the Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones by the same amount. (This is the normal behavior of Zoom and isn't unique to Rangefinder)

enhanced (
#e Passively grants 5 Handling.
)

title absRecoil (
Absolute Recoil represents how closely grouped your shots will be in the physical environment to an observer. The recoil you experience on-screen will remain identical but due to being more zoomed-in, your bullets will end up being grouped closer.
)
